context: Asuka helps Riku with English pronunciation.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: language lesson; vocabulary (小学生/学者/発音/優秀/はじめて) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生、発音が難しいんです。
lines.style: earnest teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 小学生の頃から、慣れると楽ですよ。
lines.en: If you get used to it from elementary age, it's easier.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はじめて、こんなに練習しました。
lines.en: It's the first time I've practiced this much.
lines.style: determined teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はじめてとは思えない、優秀さですよ。
lines.en: Such skill it doesn't seem like your first time.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 有名な学者も、苦労したんですか?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、優秀な学者も発音には苦労します。
lines.en: Yes, even excellent scholars struggle with pronunciation.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 小学生にも、教えられますか?
lines.en: Could I teach elementary kids too?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 優秀な君なら、きっとできますよ。
lines.en: Talented as you are, you surely can.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm encouraging closing clarity throughout
